records.title: Technical Fault in AMSS.
details: a to c): Airports Authority of India (AAI) has been directed to carry out a comprehensive audit of all Communication, Navigation, and Surveillance (CNS) equipment across the airports to evaluate their condition, operational. reliability, and lifecycle management.

records.title: Ease of Doing Business
details: a to d: So far, sic editions of BRAP (2015,2016,2017-18,2019,2020, and 2022) have been completed, and States/UTs have been assessed. The seventh edition, BRAP 2024, is currently in progress.

records.title: Railway Projects in Andhra Pradesh.
details: (i) Stretch of 56 kms of Bhadrachalam- Sathupalli railway line was completed in May, 2022, and on the rest of the portion, the work is going on. I will follow up with the State Government to expedite the project. (ii) I have taken note of the demand for ROBs which the hon. MP has made.

records.title: CIVIL AVIATION PROJECTS IN ANDHRA PRADESH
details:
a to f: AAI has undertaken the construction of New Integrated Terminal Building including Apron and allied works at Vijayawada Airport, construction of ATC tower cum technical block at Tirupati Airport, construction of New domestic Departure Terminal Building at Kadapa Airport and construction of New Domestic Terminal Building at Rajahmundry Airport in Andhra Pradesh.
With the budgetary support of Rs. 1000 Crore, GoI has approved the proposal of Revival/Development of 50 more unserved and underserved Airports/ Helipads/Water Aerodromes and Advance Landing Grounds (ALGs) during the period of 03 years i.e. years from 01.04.2023 to 31.03.2026

records.title: ASPIRE SCHEME IN ANDHRA PRADESH
details:
(I) माननीय अध्यक्षजी, माननीय सदस्य की इच्छा है कि जिलों में और व्यवस्था की जाए, इस पर हम विचार करेंगे। 
(II) उस प्रश्न को हमने संज्ञान में लिया है और हम यथासंभव ज़्यादा से ज़्यादा लोगो को एंगेज करने और ऑपर्च्युनिटी अफ़्फोर्ड कराने का प्रयास करेंगे। मैं आपके माध्यम से यह माननीय सदस्य को बताना चाहता हूँ

records.title: Polavaram Project
details: Also, the CAG has undertaken the Performance Audit of Polavaram Irrigation Project covering the period from 2017-18 to 2022-23, and the report in this regard is awaited.
